title: CE69009: Design And Evaluation Of Transportation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

CE69009 Design and Evaluation of Transportation Facilities (0-0-3) 2
CreditsData Processing and Graphical Presentation using Mathematical and
Statistical Packages, Geometric Design and drawing of various Transportation
facilities using softwares, Exercises in Monte Carlo simulation of Traffic
Flow. Exercise in EIA, Project Evaluation using HDM-IV software, problems in
analysis and design of pavements, Exercises in design of intersections,
Problems related to Transportation Planning and airport planning.
